prompt:
Reference images: image 1 shows the chosen MAGMA CONE, image 2 shows the chosen EMBER WISP. Draw every referenced subject exactly as designed — same silhouette, proportions, colour palette, materials and rendering — gathered into the sheet described below; where the description and a reference disagree on a detail of a design, follow the reference: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art, flat colored pixel sprites with crisp 1-pixel near-black navy outlines and simple two-tone dithered shading, arranged as a clean sprite sheet on a completely flat solid pure bright green chroma-key background, no scenery, no glow bleeding into the background, no text, no labels, no UI. Organized in horizontal bands: top band — a squat volcanic MAGMA CONE turret in five states: sealed cone of stacked black basalt plates with cold gray seams, first crack glowing cherry, crater opening with tangerine light, full eruption with a short orange flame cap, and a spent cone puffing gray smoke. Middle band — an EMBER WISP in six frames: a small feral flame, molten-gold round core with ragged orange-red tongues and a thin sparking tail, the flame body licking and bending differently each frame, plus two tiny variants of half and quarter size. Bottom band — projectile and effect pixels: round bullets with bright cores and dark rims in pink and red, a fan of three molten shot, single falling lava droplets with gold spark trails, and four small orange-to-red explosion puffs in growth order from spark to bloom. Chunky readable silhouettes, saturated limited palette, every sprite facing left, crisp pixel-grid edges. The background is one perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key colour everywhere around the subject: no gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast or drop shadow, no glow or green spill on the subject. Enemy bullets are round glowing orbs with bright cores and dark rims. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermark anywhere.
 Every shot on the sheet is a round glowing orb: the fan of three molten shot is three small round orange orbs spread in a fan, never cartridges, pills or rods. The top band shows all five cone states, starting with a fully sealed dark cone with no glow at all.
negative: text, labels, letters, numbers, watermark, photograph, 3d render, smooth gradients, anti-aliased, glow on background, scenery, flat background replaced, fused sprites, overlapping sprites, pure black background, perspective distortion, green tint on the subject, green spill, background scenery, cast shadow
